prompt: Use the attached image as the exact design reference: keep the same character, pose, framing, markings, accessories and color choices, and redraw it as a more detailed finished illustration in the same visual language. Dice Duel game avatar: a cozy flat sticker illustration that looks like a polished vector drawing. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Palette of the game: warm cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8. Head and shoulders, centered, facing the viewer, bold readable silhouette that still reads at 40 pixels, charming but adult, not chibi, not childish. No text, no letters, no frame, no transparency. Plain flat solid pure chroma-key green background (#00ff00) filling the whole image around the subject and inside any gaps (such as a cup handle), with no shadow, no texture and no other objects. The subject itself must not use this bright green anywhere, and its colors must not be tinted by the background. The thick dark outline is the outermost edge of the subject: no white or cream sticker border or halo around it. A steaming porcelain teacup on a saucer, cream with a terracotta band, dark tea, soft steam. No face.
